g.text: Load cell wire colours: red E+, black E-, green A+, white A-.

g.desc: Load cell wire colours: red E+, black E-, green A+, white A-.

g.text: Check them against your own cell.

g.desc: Check them against your own cell.

g.text: VCC and VDD are shorted at every HX711. Board-to-board runs use screw terminals.

g.desc: VCC and VDD are shorted at every HX711. Board-to-board runs use screw terminals.

g.text: 3V3, GND and SCK are split 1-to-4 by a PCT-215 lever connector per rail, per island.

g.desc: 3V3, GND and SCK are split 1-to-4 by a PCT-215 lever connector per rail, per island.

g.text: D3 to D6 serve the left island, D7 to D10 the right. Crossing wires join only at a dot.

g.desc: D3 to D6 serve the left island, D7 to D10 the right. Crossing wires join only at a dot.
